    A quick guide

    1. Set your pace.

      Pick 5, 10 or 15 questions and a time limit. Each quiz draws unique questions from a bank of 30.

    2. Choose before time runs out.

      Click an answer or press 1–4. Your first choice is final. A timeout reveals the correct answer and earns no point.

    3. Learn from the feedback.

      Green means correct, red means incorrect, and amber means timed out. Text labels explain every state.

    4. Take your results with you.

      Review your score and explanations, or download a PDF. Start a fresh quiz whenever you're ready.

    The timer keeps counting in background tabs. Your name stays in this browser and in any PDF you download.

    Leave this session?

    Your current answers will be discarded. You can start a fresh quiz any time.
